purpose: Open-bottom desktop separation / upright paper-book display digital concept

applicability.shape: Two straight planar longitudinal rails and 3..6 repeated transverse slotted planar dividers, perpendicular layout only
applicability.scale: Permitted numeric inputs below; only presets and named boundary tuples have been measured
applicability.curvature: Fixed 18mm top shoulder radius in revision2 and 0.55mm three-segment edge bevel; no arbitrary freeform/warped sheets
applicability.material: Opaque satin appearance only; not a physical material or strength simulation
applicability.presentation: Fixed orthographic studio, AgX, neutral ground, CPU128samples960px; actual browser/GPU/phone unverified

invariants: constant sheet thickness within one model
slot width equals sheet thickness plus nominal total clearance before bevel
divider slot top at half rail height plus clearance before final floor alignment
equal station spacing and fixed edge overhang18mm
post-bevel each mesh floor aligned to z0
actual local left/right/top clearance audited independently; no pair exemptions
dependent_constraints: exact finite numeric keys; booleans rejected; dividers exact integer
finite_scope: Three presets plus two joint boundary tuples, not continuous envelope certification. Input acceptance is not geometric validation; every new configuration must run actual-file gates.
failure_boundaries: First explicit triangle caps at lower tuple generated zero-area cap triangles and bevel collapse. Fixed by native concave polygon cap representation before bevel; original failure report retained.
Below permitted dimensions or insufficient ligaments/shoulder clearance rejected.
No elastic fit, fasteners, load, tipping, manufacturing tolerance, material durability or real assembly validation.
Motion is independent sampled +Z poses only; arbitrary rotation/trajectory not supported.

reproducibility.resource_cost: Elapsed generation/render times in each model-info; machine-dependent, not a cost guarantee

quality_gates: native closedness/local winding/world directed volume/duplicate and degenerate triangles
local cross/self overlap and positive-area coplanar detection
actual GLB structure and oriented world triangle multiset vs native, not merely file exists
actual ray slot widths, thickness, both side clearances, midlap vertical gap, floor and studio separation
finite translated poses and independent deliberate bad controls
CPU multiview human review; separate web and GPU gates

adoption.inherited: 009 hash binding, native/actual GLB separation and negative controls; retained for traceability
adoption.new: Two-sided actual slot surface probes, floor alignment, explicit no contact exemptions
adoption.not_adopted: 009 articulated lamp formula/poses, irrelevant to perpendicular sheet lattice
